stem: What were these Hawaiian citizens protesting?

options.label: F
options.text: The forced annexation of the islands as a U.S. territory after the overthrow of the Hawaiian monarchy

options.label: G
options.text: The classification of the islands as a protectorate after the Hawaiian government signed a treaty with the United States

options.label: H
options.text: The granting of U.S. statehood to the islands after they were purchased from the Hawaiian monarch

options.label: J
options.text: The colonization of the islands by political refugees from the United States

visual_elements: To His Excellency William McKinley, President, and the Senate, of the United States of America . . .  We, the undersigned, native Hawaiian citizens . . . who are members of the Hawaiian Patriotic League of the Hawaiian Islands, and others who are in sympathy with the said League, earnestly protest against the . . . [addition] of the said Hawaiian Islands to the said United States of America in any form or shape. — Petition, 1897
